exception: ValueError: Table schema does not match schema used to create file; Flight_Number_Reporting_Airline changed from int64 to float64 between CSV chunks
root_cause: The first 200,000-row CSV chunk contained only integral flight-number identifiers, while a later chunk contained a missing identifier. Pandas therefore inferred different physical dtypes for the same source column across chunks.
impact: The create-only final census manifest was not written. Completed partitions through 2024-07 remain immutable and are rehashed on resume. The incomplete 2024-08 Parquet .part file is not eligible evidence.
resolution: Normalize the identifier to a fixed int64 physical type in every chunk, encode an unknown identifier as -1, cover the exact transition with a regression test, quarantine the incomplete .part file, and resume without replacing completed partitions.
